book.title: Malobhe gha Mbone ngita chighajhandikwe na Matei

content: Bhahenga lihengo mughonda gwa michabibo
“Unahota gwa kunane kwa Chapanga ulandine na mundo jhumo jwabhii na nng'onda gwa michabibo. Jwalabhite lukela kwapalaha bhando bhakuhenga lihengo munng'onda gwake.
Ajhakughana nabho kwalepa mbijha kipande chimo cha madine gha feza kwa lichiko, peniya ajhakwapeleka kunng'onda gwake gwa michabibo.
Puhikila chaa tato jha lukela, ajhakubhoka kabhele ajhakwabhona bhando bhange bhajemite mu maghuliho, bhakwete jhe chakuhenga.
Ajhakwalobholela, ‘Nnyende na mangota mukahenge lihengo munng'onda gwango gwa michabibo, na nenga naninepa.’
Bhahe, bhajhakujhenda. Nkolo nng'onda jwenio ajhakubhoka kabhele puhikila chaa chita na chaa ticha, na ticha ajhakutenda helahela.

Puhikila chaa kome na jhimo jha kimiye, ajhakujhenda kabhele, ajhakukongana na bhando bhange bhajhemangine palighuliho pala. Bhahe, ajhakwakonya, ‘Nhwalo ghane ngohe mpipikiye muhe jhoha changalihengo pambano?’
Na bhene bhajhakunyanguu, ‘Nhwalo abhii jhe mundo jwatupikiye lihengo.’ Peniya ajhakwalobholela, ‘Mangota helahela nnyende mukahenge kunng'onda gwango gwa michabibo.’
“Pulitipika lyobha, nkolo nghonda ajhakunnobholela jwajhemelela jhola, ‘Mwakeme bhubhahengita lihengo na mwalepe malepo ghabhe, ntumbula kwa bhala bhakujhomolela ade kwa bhala bhibhalongolila.’
Bhahe, bhala pibhatumbwila kuhenga chaa kome na jhimo jha kimiye, kila jhumo ajhakulepwa mbijha kipande chimo cha madine gha feza.
Na bhala bhibhakatumbwile kuhenga lukela bhahambwika nabhajhonjekewa mbijha henge, nambo nabhene bhajhakulepwa kipande chimo cha madine gha feza kila jhumo.
Pibhapokila malepo ghabhe bhajhakutumbuu kunkokolekeya nkolo nng'onda.
Bhalongila, ‘Bhando bhamba bhubhahikite kujhomolela bhahengite kwa lichaa limo tugha, nambo mwalepite ngita twenga bhutuhengita lihengo muhe jhoha pa lyobha?’
Nkolo nng'onda jhola ajhakunnyanguu jhumo pakate jhabhe, ‘Makoche, niponjite ndeka kilebhe. Bho, tughalaghine ndeka malepo gha kipande chimo cha madine gha mbijha kwa lichiko?
Bhahe, npokele feza jhino nnyende. Nipala kupekeya jhonjo jhunimpeila lihengo lya kujhomolela ngita mwenga.
Bho, nihoto jhe kuhenga chochoha chinipala kwa ilebhe yango? Nhwalo gwa nike umeke wiho nenga naumbone?’ ”
Yecho ajhomolila kwa kulonge, “Ndi naibhaha, bhakujhomolela nabhabhaha bhakutumbula na bhakutumbuu nabhabhaha bhakujhomolela.”
Yecho ilonge mala jha utato malobhe gha kuwee kwake
Yecho pahohwika kujhenda ku Yeluchalemo, ajhakwaghegha bhabholwa bhake kome na bhabhele na kulonge nabho kongo bhakityanga mundela pangabhando na kwalobholela,
Ajhakwalobholela, “Unyokanikiye tujhenda ku Yeluchalemo na kwenio Mwana gwa Mundo nabhankamuha kwa Akapiya matambiko bhakolo na bhabhola bha Malaghalikilo. Na bhene nabhanhadabulwa akomwe,
peniya napelekwa kwa bhando bha ilambo henge. Na bhene nabhantendela chanake na kunnapula yato na kumamba panane jha nchalaba, nambo lichiko lya utato nayokechwa.”
Majhe anyopa Yecho
Peniya majhe yana mundo Zebedayo pamonga na yana yake ibhele ajhakunyendela Yecho. Bhahe, majhe jhola ajhakutama makilikite palonge jha Yecho, kwa kunnyopa antendele chakipala.

Yecho ajhakunkonya, “Bho, mipala nike?” Na jwenio ajhakujhanguu, “Chonde mwalobholele kubhehe yana yango ibhele nabhatama jhumo lubhoko lwalelo na jhonge lubhoko lwa ngejha pumipala kubhehe mu Nahota gwino.”
Yecho ajhakwalobholela, “Umanyite jhe chimujhopa. Bho, mihoto kunywegha mukibaba cha malagho chininywegha nenga?” Na bhene bhajhakunyanguu, “Tuhotola.”

Yecho ajhakwalobhalela, “Ninongolela chakaka, naunywela kibaba chango cha malagho, nambo kutama lubhoko lwalelo amu lwa ngejha, lihengo lyango ndeka kupanga. Kilebhe i napelwa bhala bhubhalenganikilwe na Tate gwango.”
Bhala bhabholwa bhange kome pibhajhohina malobhe gheniya, bhajhakwayomela akalongo bheniya bhabhele.
Bhahe, Yecho ajhakwakema bhoha na kwalobholela, “Umanye ilongoche ya nnema ulongocha bhando kwa makakala, na bhakolo bheniya ubhatenda bhando kubhehe bhabhe.
Nambo kwa mangota nahijhe, nambo jwapala kubhehe nkolongwa pakate jhino abhehe ntumiche jwa bhoha,
na jwapala kubhehe nkolongwa pakate jhino bhoha, ipalwa abhaha ntumiche jwino.
Ngita chabhii Mwana gwa Mundo jwenio ahikiti jhe kuhengelwa, nambo kunhengela na kubhoha ughome gwake kwakombola bhando bhamahele.”
Yecho abhalamicha bhangalola bhabhele
Yecho na bhabholwa bhake pubhabhokita ku Yeliko, lilongo lya bhando lijhakwakengama.
Bhahe, pakibha na bhando bhabhele bhangalola bhatamita muupele jha ndela. Pubhajhohina Yecho atenda kupeta bhajhakunonoha malobhe, “Bhambo, Mwana gwa Daude umonele kiya!”
Lilongo lya bhando lela lijhakwapwatalila, bhalongolila bhatame nuu. Nambo bhene bhajhakuchocha kulalama, bhalongila, “Bhambo, Mwana gwa Daude, mutubhone kiya!”
Yecho ajhakujhema na ajhakwakema na kwakonya, “Bho, mipala nintendele nike mangota?”
Na bhene bhajhakunyanguu, “Bhambo, tujhopa tulole!”
Bhahe, Yecho ajhakwabhonela kiya, ajhakupapaha miho ghabhe. Papa bhajhakulola, na kunkengama.
